# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" text
- **Center**: "Files" text
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 21:13"
  - System notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Wallpaper
- Abstract geometric pattern with gradient colors transitioning from deep purple to red-orange
- Faint, stylized floral or petal-like shapes in the center

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - Files application icon (currently active, highlighted with black tooltip "Files")
  - Ubuntu Software icon (orange square with white "A")
  - Help icon (blue circle with white question mark)
  - Terminal icon (black square with white command prompt symbol)
  - Trash icon (gray recycle bin)

## Active Application Windows

### Files Application Window
- **Title Bar**: "Home"
- **Navigation Bar**:
  - Back button (left arrow)
  - Forward button (right arrow)
  - Home button (house icon)
  - Address bar showing "Home"
  - Three-dot menu button
  - Search button (magnifying glass)
  - View options button (three horizontal lines)
  - Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)
- **Left Sidebar Navigation**:
  - "Recent" (with clock icon)
  - "Starred" (with star icon)
  - "Home" (with house icon, currently selected)
  - "Desktop" (with folder icon)
  - "Documents" (with document icon)
  - "Downloads" (with download icon)
  - "Music" (with musical note icon)
  - "Pictures" (with image icon)
  - "Videos" (with video camera icon)
  - "Trash" (with trash can icon)
  - "Other Locations" (with plus icon)
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid of files and folders
  - **Top Row**:
    - Desktop (folder icon with gradient)
    - Documents (folder with document icon)
    - Downloads (folder with download icon)
    - Music (folder with musical note icon)
    - Pictures (folder with image icon)
    - Public (folder with share icon)
    - requirements.txt (text file icon)
  - **Second Row**:
    - server (folder)
    - snap (folder)
    - Templates (folder)
    - Videos (folder)
    - .bash_history (text file)
    - .bash_logout (text file)
    - .bashrc (text file)
  - **Third Row**:
    - .cache (folder)
    - .config (folder)
    - .gnupg (folder)
    - .ipython (folder)
    - .lesshst (text file)
    - .local (folder)
    - .mozilla (folder)
  - **Fourth Row**:
    - .pki (folder)
    - .profile (text file)
    - .selected_editor (text file)
    - .ssh (folder)
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful (text file)
    - thunderbird (folder)
    - .var (folder)
  - **Fifth Row**:
    - .viminfo (text file)
    - .vscode (folder)

### Terminal Window
- **Title Bar**: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, Close
- **Terminal Content**:
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Partially typed command: "cd Desk" with cursor at the end
  - Background color: dark purple
  - Text color: light green for prompt, white for command

## Desktop Icon
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - "Home" folder icon (gray folder with house symbol)
  - Text label: "Home"
